context: WrestleMania 42 Night 2 — generational succession night. 6 matches. Loaded gun from Night 1 (Heyman/Breakker) stayed holstered; every match resolved clean.

segments.outcome: Oba Femi defeated Brock Lesnar decisively and quickly. Post-match, Oba gave Lesnar a symbolic acknowledgment. Lesnar removed gloves and boots, left them in the ring — retirement grammar. Crowd chanted 'Thank you Brock.' Paul Heyman came out and embraced him.
segments.notes: Creation myth and conscious death in the same three-count. WM streak seeded (1-0). Lesnar = Surtr integrated, not hibernated. All integration indicators present: decisive defeat, voluntary symbol release, crowd gratitude, successor's acknowledgment, handler completing emotional arc. Destruction archetype bifurcated: Oba inherits mythic weight, Breakker inherits institutional weapon function.

segments.outcome: Penta retained the Intercontinental Championship in a ladder match. JD McDonagh did not capture the title.
segments.notes: Workers' belt thesis confirmed — IC title tells you who the office crowns as 'the worker.' Penta holds that designation. Ladder matches remain Fortuna's province; resist applying structural logic to chaos formats. JD elevation trajectory (Dom/JD future feud, Liv gravitating toward the earner) remains alive through a different door.

segments.outcome: Finn Bálor (as The Demon) defeated Dominik Mysterio in a Street Fight. Dom entered with AAA Championship and Spanish/Mexican crew. Full Demon entrance at production scale. WM41 deferred justice paid.
segments.notes: WM41 debt (Dom pinned Bálor for IC title) paid one year later. Dom's AAA Championship = his one non-borrowed piece of legitimacy. Street fight = Fomorian's natural habitat (outside civilization's constraints). Children scared during Demon entrance; Dom's face showed genuine fear. Steal-the-show candidate. Scroll 001 insert has its shape — the Fomorian eye opened.

segments.outcome: Trick Williams defeated Sami Zayn cleanly to win the United States Championship.
segments.notes: Clean finish inverts the 'corrupted demihero shortcuts' thesis — Trick won without cheating. Generational succession (world-state tension #5) overrode integrity tension (#6). Part of Night 2's generational current: Oba over Brock (mythic), Trick over Sami (demihero). Both decisive, respectful, absolute. Sami's Conscience archetype didn't fail — the collective chose differently.

segments.outcome: Rhea Ripley defeated Jade Cargill to win the Women's World Championship. Michin and B-Fab interfered for Jade; IYO Sky neutralized them and cleared the path. Rhea won clean. Rhea wore white gear with hand-written text. Jade's entrance featured full wind/storm costume.
segments.notes: Meta-kayfabe obligation confirmed. Fourth-wall break (Rhea invoked 'Demi') honored with clean coronation. White gear = coronation signal (Undertaker WM20, Cody WM40 pattern). Jade's storm-costume unconsciously confirmed Oya archetype. IYO's intervention = feminine solidarity; Bride-Who-Became-Queen protected another woman's sovereignty. Jade's loss = descent phase of Oya cycle, not burial.

segments.outcome: Roman Reigns defeated CM Punk cleanly to win the WWE Championship (7th world title). Roman's entrance honored his full family; Sika's presence acknowledged. No interference from Heyman/Breakker despite Night 1 setup. 10/10 clean finish.
segments.notes: 15-year meta-kayfabe debt paid in full. Alchemical reciprocals resolved without third-force interference. Sika thread closes — Roman's entrance, Punk's go-home apology, and clean finish all honored the family name. Coniunctio completed: mutual confession was the wedding, match was the consummation. Transformed king earned what was originally handed for the wrong reasons. Post-Poseidon completes: rejected by the ocean (2014-20), tyrant of the ocean (2020-24), lost the ocean (WM40), earns it back clean (WM42).
